svg.title: dex.place layout 3: hub and spokes. Map to scale (1 H = 4 px) and pacing along the first-visit loop.
svg.text: Side view, drawn to scale: 1 H (player height, 80 world px) = 4 px here. Solid outline = indoors, dashed = outdoors. Thin grey dashes = the first-visit loop, numbered in order.
the plain (colossi walk west, toward the ring)
the ring hull, behind (the chapel is built on it)

svg.text: Content: account counter + shrine S1 in B1 (about 40 s from spawn) · map banner in B2 · Documentation: an ordinary door from B2 down into B3 · Downloads: arena terminal in D4 (lift from B2)
Illustrations: 9 works in E6 · donation shrines S1 B1, S2 C3, S3 D3, S4 E2, S5 E5 · the four views (A0, C4, D5, E7) get a bench only, no box · the website is one scroll away everywhere
Two readings of the same 28 steps. Top: how big the space feels. Bottom: how calm or tense it is. The loop alternates big and small, and the storm peaks once, in the middle.
